title: Environment bundle
description: One bundle describes exactly one deployable environment (one Kubernetes namespace): what runs there and at which version. It never describes HOW something is deployed (that is the chart) nor WITH WHAT configuration (that is values/). It is the only file a release touches, and the only file the renderer reads.

name.description: Unique bundle identifier, used as the prefix of every generated resource name (e.g. '<platform>-dev' -> HelmRelease '<platform>-dev-<service>'). Must contain the environment directory name, because promotion between environments relies on that correspondence.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace every component is deployed into. Also the subdomain segment in service URLs: {service}.{namespace}.{publishDomain}.

publishDomain.description: Base domain for exposed services. Passed to charts as global.publishDomain. Omit for an environment that exposes nothing.

imageRegistry.description: Registry prefix for service images. A chart resolves image.repository = {imageRegistry}/{service}. Passed to charts as global.imageRegistry.

vaultPathPrefix.description: Secret-store path prefix for this environment (e.g. 'dev'). ExternalSecret keys resolve as {vaultPathPrefix}/{path}, so a dev bundle structurally cannot read production keys. Passed to charts as global.vaultPathPrefix.

imagePullSecret.description: Name of the dockerconfigjson Secret used to pull both images and OCI charts. Must already exist in the target namespace AND in the Flux namespace; it is provisioned by the infra repo, not here.

interval.description: Reconcile interval applied to every generated resource. Default 30m.

microservices.description: Application services owned by this platform. Each entry deploys one chart published by that service's own repository.

service.description: One string with three roles: the chart name, the values filename (values/{service}.yaml), and the generated resource name suffix. Never let them diverge.

repoURL.description: OCI registry base, WITHOUT the chart name. The renderer appends /{service}.

chartVersion.description: EXACT version. Ranges are rejected by construction: a range means nobody can state what is running, and a rollback stops being a revert.

disabled.description: Skip rendering this entry without deleting it, so the pinned version survives the outage window. Prefer this over commenting the block out.

platform.description: Third-party platform components this environment needs (message bus, databases, vector store). Cluster-wide operators do NOT belong here — they are owned by the infra repo.

component.description: Release name and values filename (values/{component}.yaml). Separate from 'chart' so the same chart can be deployed twice under different names.

chart.description: Chart name inside repoURL. Explicit rather than inferred, because a third-party chart name rarely equals the release name.

repoURL.description: OCI registry base, WITHOUT the chart name. The renderer appends /{chart}.

disabled.description: Skip rendering without losing the pin.
